name: codex-task-tools
description: Create and track durable local Codex tasks in existing backend projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create and track local Codex tasks in verified projects.
interface.longDescription: Find existing Codex backend projects, create one durable task for an explicit request, submit its initial prompt once, and read back its status and pending approvals. A private local broker maintains execution tracking after the creation call returns.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Codex task in an existing project with this title and prompt, then give me its ID and verified status.
